items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: He had Emmett Berry; he had Sweets, Ed Lewis

ctx.x: So he'd gotten Emmett Berry in there on trumpet now?
He had Emmett Berry; he had Sweets, Ed Lewis, because you remember Al Killian had left us earlier. Before I went in the Army he left us to join Charlie Barnet.
This was '47, you say? What year was this?
